tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient measurements show a transition from positive outputs near the proposed critical gradient to negative outputs above it. Fit the recalled five-parameter avalanche-sink mechanism numerically; the predictor uses parameters fitted once by fit(train_rows), avoiding the prior undefined-variable interface failure.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the resulting high-gradient rows expose the thresholded collapse and negative outputs.
Eight observations spanning both sides of the transition suffice to fit the cited five-parameter law; another batch is not justified yet.
Cannot explain the strong gradient-associated collapse, including negative outputs, without adding unsupported terms.
A smooth positive power law cannot represent the observed sharp threshold and negative high-gradient responses.
